attr.title: Das Erbe
attr.desc: A C#/.NET reimplementation of the German point-and-click adventure Das Erbe, with several quality-of-life features added on top of the 1991 original.
attr.desc_md:
A C#/.NET reimplementation of the German point-and-click adventure *Das Erbe*, not just a straight port of the 1991 original. 
It adds several quality-of-life features:

- **Hotspot highlighting** (mapped to `Y` in this port): flashes every interactive hotspot on screen.
- **Click-to-action / mouse-over hovering**: hotspot hints show on hover, skipping the original's separate confirmation click.
- **Translation overlay support**.
- **DKSN fallback-response mode**: varied German fallback responses for hotspot actions with no scripted response, instead of nothing.
- **Amiga intro music**.
- **In-game keypad support via keyboard/numpad**.
attr.inst: Install via PortMaster and run. The original game files are bundled with the port
